exposure: maternal age less than 18 years vs 18-20 years
cohort: This cross-sectional study included pregnant women aged less than 20 years.
finding: Neonatal mortality and low one- and five-minute Apgar scores were higher in this study of pregnant women under 20 years old compared to previous studies.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was performed in 51.8% of the mothers.
